sections.Profile:
The "Star Wars Trilogy" pinball machine, released by Sega in March 1997, features design work by Joe Balcer and Joe Kaminkow. It incorporates two flippers, one ramp, and a four-ball multiball mode, with sound and music by Brian Schmidt and John Williams. Based on the original Star Wars trilogy, the machine includes thematic elements such as iconic characters and scenes.
